topic: Updating category names in analytics system
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed the technical process of renaming a location category (Mall to Mall_telt240) for Provantage Africa. It was confirmed that changing the name is possible, provided all related assets, model bindings, and calibration links are updated.

[p1] reported updating the `ml_model` table in PostgreSQL and the `facility_dict` table in ClickHouse (CH). [me] questioned which other locations needed updates. It was clarified that the category Mall was split into two new categories: Mall_telt240 and Mall_telt200.

[me] confirmed updating the necessary dictionaries within CH, and [p1] stated they would check the night calculation results the following day.
decisions: The location category name change is technically feasible if all related assets and bindings are updated.
action_items: Someone will check the status of the night calculation process on the next day.
